title: Calibrated Germline Architecture of 62 Hereditary Cancer Genes Across 9,768 Genomes and 82 Endogamous Indian Communities: Data and Reproducible Pipeline
description:
Reproducible code, curated variant adjudication catalogs, MaveDB/SpliceAI sensitivity tables, Wahlund community stratification outputs, penetrance-adjusted PAF models, gallbladder GWAS risk-allele stratification, and 600-DPI figures supporting the manuscript Calibrated Germline Architecture of 62 Hereditary Cancer Genes Across 9,768 Genomes and 82 Endogamous Indian Communities Reconciled with National Cancer Surveillance (Target journal: Familial Cancer, Springer Nature).

Contents:

  • tables/: Complete Tables 1-7, Supplementary Sensitivity Tables M1-M5, full 6,277-variant audit (ESM_2_Complete_62Gene_Variant_Audit.csv), 15-tab master workbook (ESM_1_Familial_Cancer_62Gene_Workbook.xlsx), and code archive (ESM_3).
  • data_cancer/ & data_lynch/: Extracted rare variant tables across 82 decoded Indian communities, ClinVar SPDI / gnomAD v4.1 / SpliceAI caches, MaveDB functional datasets, ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA2 VCEP v1.2 calibration data, and Cancer Samiksha 2016-2025 projections.
  • scripts/ & root runner scripts: Full end-to-end Python pipeline implementing SPDI verification, MANE Select PVS1 rules, MAVE/SpliceAI sensitivity bounds, community-stratified Wahlund/NNS modeling, Levin PAF clinical-share models, and 600-DPI figure generation.
  • figures_manuscript/: Seven publication-ready 600-DPI figures (Figs 1-7).

Licensing note: Curated data tables and figures are shared under CC BY 4.0; Python code is shared under the MIT License (see LICENSE).

notes: Raw multi-gigabyte GenomeIndia Phase 1 chromosome TSVs and DBT/IBDC GI-DB files are publicly accessible via the Indian Biological Data Centre (https://ibdc.dbt.gov.in/gidb/) and are referenced rather than redistributed verbatim. Derived extracted rare variant sets (<1% AF across all 62 genes) and 82-population frequency matrices needed to reproduce all manuscript tables and figures offline are included.
